steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Look.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: This is the trigger.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Just load the ammo like this...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Aim at the enemy, and pull the trigger.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: This will launch the bullet...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Then concentrate, and grip the handle.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Concentrate... and channel your Arts.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: This will cause the bullet to detonate.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I don't know if I can...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: I know you can do this.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: We have a lot in common. I can feel it within you.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Just picture it in your mind...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Here, hold on to this Originium shard.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Nnh...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Concentrate.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: My palm feels... hot.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: That's right!

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: I knew it, I knew it...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Yes, Misha, you really are... Haha, ahaha...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: You really are my...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...We have to go! Skullshatterer, hurry!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We can't hold this base anymore!

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: What happened?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Rhodes Island is attacking! We're being rushed!

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Those bastards...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Don't panic. Regroup and prepare our counterattack!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Skullshatterer...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I'm sure... Rhodes Island will...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Will what? You want me to have a chat with Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: They, they're surely trying to help the Infected.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: They killed so many of my comrades...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: You're really asking me to talk to them?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: All my comrades... they were Infected too!

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Rhodes Island, those self-proclaimed saviors of the Infected... what did they do to help my comrades?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: What did they say to you to blind you?!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I don't know...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Sorry...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: I'm getting too emotional.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: But one thing is certain...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Reunion has finally provided a sliver of hope to the Infected after all this time...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: But Rhodes Island, despite being Infected, chose to hurt us, to slaughter us!

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: What are they but traitors?!

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: What is there to discuss with traitors?!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Are the Infected doomed to always kill each other then?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Then, what am I supposed to do...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Should I just stand by and watch my comrades die?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Don't worry.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: We'll protect you.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: You'll also have to protect yourself though...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Don't get pulled into the fighting.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Please be careful...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Promise... you'll come back...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Just when I finally found you again...

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Yeah. I'll come back for you.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Then, we'll go home together...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: ...Mhm.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hey there.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So, you need my help after all?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Actually... the situation is a bit different from what Talulah told us.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: The enemy is more powerful than we expected.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: That's why... you have to protect Misha.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I don't think I'm obligated to do that.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: You are.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Fine, fine.

steps.name: W
steps.text: However, it's not enough to just protect Misha, is it?

steps.name: W
steps.text: If you fail, they'll still catch up to us.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: What do you have in mind?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Skullshatterer, don't you remember what I told you before?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: ...I do.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: We can turn the tables if we take out that target.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}...

steps.name: W
steps.text: See, you were paying attention. All we have to do is take out their commander. Easy, right?

steps.name: W
steps.text: The hooded person who's always next to that bunny girl.

steps.name: W
steps.text: The person who leads Rhodes Island's combat operations.

steps.name: W
steps.text: If you can kill that one... Bang!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Just like that, their brain will be gone.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Everything will be so easy after that~

steps.name: W
steps.text: We don't have many troops left, and we're running out of options.

steps.name: W
steps.text: There's a location near the front of the mines that will be great for setting up our ambush.

steps.name: W
steps.text: My casters will provide cover for you... You know what to do, don't you?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'll use my troops to draw them here.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't miss this opportunity~

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: ...Take care of Misha for me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Sure thing~

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hmph... Anyways, good luck.
